strengths: Clean separation of concerns: event subscription, DB insertion, and push delivery are distinct layers
Actor exclusion logic is consistent and correct across all card event handlers
registerPush() dependency injection avoids circular import with sse.ts — good architectural choice
initNotificationService() returns a proper cleanup function that removes all 6 event listeners
All 8 tests pass with correct mocking of pool.query via vi.mock
onCardDueDateRemoved correctly delegates to onCardDueDateChanged with newDueDate=null (DRY)
Dedup for welcome messages uses 24h SELECT as specified, not a unique index

issues.description: onCardDeleted (line 129) silently swallows errors via void pool.query(...) — insertNotification has try/catch but the UPDATE path does not. Low risk since card deletion is rare and the consequence is just stale source_deleted flags, but inconsistent with other handlers.

No dedicated test for card:dueDateRemoved event — the implementation correctly delegates to onCardDueDateChanged (verified by code inspection), but a direct test would catch regressions if the delegation is refactored.
